en.title: ProbeMatchDTI: Probe-Driven Multi-Scale Biochemical Pattern Matching for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
en.hook: Advance AI-driven drug discovery by improving drug-target interaction prediction through active pattern matching.
key_takeaways: Improves drug-target interaction (DTI) prediction in computational drug discovery
Introduces probe-driven active multi-scale biochemical pattern matching
Overcomes limitations of passive feature learning in representation methods
